result.instructions: Tools for Nango, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which integrations are set up in our Nango environment, and which connections do they have?"; "Show the status of the GitHub issues sync for our main connection."; "List the last synced Issue records for connection acme-prod since yesterday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Nango data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nango_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nango_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nango_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nango_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nango_list_integrations
tools.title: List integrations
tools.description: List the integrations (provider setups with a unique key) in this Nango environment, without credentials. Start here to find a provider_config_key. Nango API: GET /integrations.

tools.name: nango_get_integration
tools.title: Get an integration
tools.description: Get one integration by its unique key: provider, display name and config, without client secrets. Nango API: GET /integrations/{uniqueKey}.

provider_config_key.description: The integration's unique key (provider_config_key) from nango_list_integrations.

tools.name: nango_list_connections
tools.title: List connections
tools.description: List connections (one per connected end user account) without tokens: id, provider, status, tags and errors. Filter by search text, end user id or limit. Nango API: GET /connections.

search.description: Free text to match connection fields.

end_user_id.description: Only connections tagged with this end user id.

tools.name: nango_get_connection
tools.title: Get a connection
tools.description: Get one connection's metadata, status and errors by connection id, without tokens. Uses the list route with a connectionId filter, because the single-connection route returns credentials. Nango API: GET /connections?connectionId=.

connection_id.description: The connection id, as the app set it when the connection was created.

provider_config_key.description: Integration key; needed when several integrations share the connection id.

tools.name: nango_get_sync_status
tools.title: Get sync status
tools.description: Get the status and last run of syncs for one integration, optionally for one connection. Use "*" for every sync. Nango API: GET /sync/status.

provider_config_key.description: The integration's unique key (provider_config_key) from nango_list_integrations.

syncs.description: Comma-separated sync names, or "*" for all syncs of the integration.

connection_id.description: The connection id, as the app set it when the connection was created.

tools.name: nango_list_records
tools.title: List synced records
tools.description: Read records that a sync stored for one connection: model, limit, cursor and modified_after for paging. Nango API: GET /records.

model.description: The synced model name, for example "Issue".

connection_id.description: The connection id, as the app set it when the connection was created.

provider_config_key.description: The integration's unique key (provider_config_key) from nango_list_integrations.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor.

modified_after.description: Only records modified after this ISO 8601 time.

tools.name: nango_start_sync
tools.title: Start syncs
tools.description: Start the schedule of named syncs for an integration (or one connection). Runs the sync now, then on its schedule. No effect if the schedule already runs. Nango API: POST /sync/start.

provider_config_key.description: The integration's unique key (provider_config_key) from nango_list_integrations.

connection_id.description: The connection id, as the app set it when the connection was created.

tools.name: nango_pause_sync
tools.title: Pause syncs
tools.description: Pause the schedule of named syncs for an integration (or one connection). Stops future scheduled runs; records already stored stay. Nango API: POST /sync/pause.

provider_config_key.description: The integration's unique key (provider_config_key) from nango_list_integrations.

connection_id.description: The connection id, as the app set it when the connection was created.

tools.name: nango_trigger_sync
tools.title: Run a sync once
tools.description: Run named syncs once now, outside their schedule, for an integration (or one connection). Pulls data from the provider and updates stored records. Nango API: POST /sync/trigger.

provider_config_key.description: The integration's unique key (provider_config_key) from nango_list_integrations.

connection_id.description: The connection id, as the app set it when the connection was created.

tools.name: nango_call_tool
tools.title: Call a tool
tools.description: Run one enabled Nango tool on a connection, synchronously. The tool acts in the connected provider, so it can create or change data there. Pass the tool input as a JSON object. Nango API: POST /connections/{connectionId}/tools/{name}/calls.

connection_id.description: The connection id, as the app set it when the connection was created.

tool_name.description: The tool name on the integration.

provider_config_key.description: Integration key; needed when several integrations share the connection id.

input.description: Input matching the tool's schema. Omit for tools without input.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Nango
prompts.description: What you can do with Nango here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_integrations_and_connections
prompts.title: Check integrations and connections
prompts.description: List the integrations of the environment, then the connections of one provider. Read a connection's status and errors, without tokens.

prompts.name: check_the_status_of_syncs
prompts.title: Check the status of syncs
prompts.description: Read the status and the last run of the syncs of one integration, or of one connection. Use the wildcard to read every sync.

prompts.name: read_synced_records
prompts.title: Read synced records
prompts.description: List the records that a sync stored for one connection. Page through them, or list only the records changed after a time.

prompts.name: pause_start_or_run_a_sync
prompts.title: Pause, start or run a sync
prompts.description: Pause the scheduled runs of named syncs, start their schedule again, or run a sync once now.

prompts.name: call_a_tool_in_a_connected_app
prompts.title: Call a tool in a connected app
prompts.description: Run one enabled tool on a connection. The tool acts in the connected app, so it can create or change data there.
